headlines.title: John Barrasso says President Trump banning media outlets doesn’t violate the U.S. Constitution
headlines.description: Senate Majority Whip John Barrasso (R-Wyo.) says “the press has an obligation to report fairly” after President Trump bans journalists from MS NOW, CNN and Politico from accessing the White House.

headlines.title: ICE officer shoots Venezuelan man in Austin, Texas, law enforcement source says
headlines.description: An ICE officer shot and seriously wounded a Venezuelan man Sunday afternoon in Austin, Texas, officials and a law enforcement source said.

headlines.title: Kornacki: 43% of voters want midterm vote to ‘signal opposition to Trump’
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki joins Meet the Press to take a look at NBC News’ latest poll on how voters feel about both parties headed into the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Journalists from MS NOW, CNN and Politico were denied access to the White House grounds Saturday, a day after President Donald Trump said on social media that he had banned the news outlets over what he called their “constant ‘reporting’ FAKE NEWS.”

headlines.title: Trump says his proposed arch will include a military complex housing drones and snipers
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said in a Sunday Truth Social post that he would convert plans for the D.C.-area “Triumphal Arch” to “a top grade Military Complex/Triumphal Arch” which could be used for snipers and drone storage.

headlines.title: Ed Sheeran calls situation in Gaza ‘unjustifiable’ in first concert since Macklemore controversy
headlines.description: Ed Sheeran fans trickled into Lincoln Financial on Saturday evening as protesters gathered outside the stadium to denounce Macklemore’s removal from Sheeran’s “Loop” tour over his pro-Palestinian advocacy.

headlines.title: New Found Glory founder and guitarist Chad Gilbert dead at 45
headlines.description: New Found Glory guitarist Chad Gilbert died “peacefully in his sleep” Sunday morning at the age of 45, his bandmates and wife said in a statement.

headlines.title: American dream of owning a home out of reach for many as mortgage rates soar (again)
headlines.description: Interest rates on a 30-year fixed mortgage soared to 7.2%. Coupled with near record high prices, it’s putting homeownership out of reach for millions.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels leaves game vs. Cowboys with elbow injury
headlines.description: Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels was ruled out of his team’s Week 2 matchup against the Dallas Cowboys after suffering an elbow injury late in the first half.
